title: Locality-Controlled Out-of-Distribution Guidance for Robust Regulatory DNA Sequence Design
abstract: arXiv:2610.41736v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Designing regulatory DNA sequences for targeted gene-expression control is an important challenge. Recent approaches frame this task as property-conditioned generation, where diffusion models trained on natural sequences are guided toward high predicted activity through reward-based fine-tuning or sampling-time guidance. We show that single-reward evaluation can obscure reward-hacking behavior. By decomposing evaluation into property, novelty, and plausibility, we identify an empirically underexplored region of the evaluation space in which all three objectives are satisfied, but no existing baseline succeeds. We postulate that this gap arises because prior methods treat guidance primarily as a matter of magnitude. In regulatory DNA, however, sequence grammar is spatially nonuniform: motif positions are sensitive to perturbation, while background regions allow more exploration. translated_title: 面向鲁棒调控DNA序列设计的局部性可控分布外引导
translated_abstract: 为实现靶向基因表达调控而设计调控DNA序列是一项重要挑战。近期的方法将这一任务框架化为属性条件生成问题，即在自然序列上训练的扩散模型，通过基于奖励的微调或采样时引导，被引导至高预测活性区域。我们表明，单一奖励的评估方式可能掩盖奖励作弊（reward hacking）行为。通过将评估分解为属性、新颖性和合理性三个维度，我们识别出评估空间中一个在实证上尚未被充分探索的区域——在该区域中三个目标均可同时满足，但没有任何现有基线方法能够成功达到。我们推测这一差距的存在是因为先前的方法主要将引导视为一个“幅度”问题。然而，在调控DNA中，序列语法在空间上是非均匀的：基序位置对扰动十分敏感，而背景区域则允许更多的探索。因此，我们通过将引导重新表述为一种局部性控制问题，提出了LOCOGEN方法……
tldr: 该论文发现单一奖励评估会掩盖奖励作弊行为，并提出LOCOGEN方法，通过将扩散模型的引导重新表述为局部性控制问题——尊重调控DNA序列语法的空间非均匀性（基序位置敏感、背景区域可探索），从而实现属性、新颖性与合理性三者兼得的鲁棒调控DNA序列设计。
en_tdlr: This paper reveals that single-reward evaluation can obscure reward hacking, and proposes LOCOGEN, which reformulates diffusion guidance as a locality-controlled problem that respects the spatially nonuniform sequence grammar of regulatory DNA—sensitive motif positions and explorable background regions—to achieve robust sequence design satisfying property, novelty, and plausibility simultaneously.
